_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Learn's page 'Manage Microsoft Entra applications using Microsoft Graph', as its source in microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib: the HTTP samples for finding ownerless service principals, assigning owners to an application and a service principal, and setting serviceManagementReference exist only inside this page. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Learn samples: Manage Microsoft Entra applications using Microsoft Graph (owners and serviceManagementReference)
license: Code: MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Documentation: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (LICENSE). Both copied from the repository root.
not_copied: The SDK snippet include files the page references (includes/snippets/*/v1/tutorial-application-basics-*.md): generated per language from the HTTP samples, which are inline in the page and are what the tests run.
The API reference pages for Add owner and List owners, which the chapter cites; everything else in microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib.
